verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents the building blocks: items can be marked Resolved, versions and deploys are tracked, and real-time alerts go to Slack, PagerDuty and webhooks. However, no evidence explicitly describes reactivation or regression detection when a resolved item recurs in a newer release, or an alert trigger kept separate from new-item alerts. missing for 10: documented reactivated/regression alert trigger, resolved-in-version semantics tying recurrence to a newer release, separation of regression alerts from new-item notifications, independent corroboration.
